title: Transparency holds when earlier processing stages are unavailable to attention

statements.text: The working definition: transparency holds if earlier processing stages are unavailable for attentional processing. Unconscious representations are neither transparent nor opaque. The degree of transparency of a phenomenal state is inversely proportional to the attentional availability of the earlier stages of its construction.
